cases.name: toplevel-python-closure-defaults
cases.template:
<%!
def decorate(fn):
    def wrapped(ctx, *args, **kwargs):
        ctx.write('[')
        result = fn(*args, **kwargs)
        ctx.write(']')
        return result
    return wrapped
%><%def name="f(x, y=2)" decorator="decorate" buffered="True">${x + y}</%def>${f(count)}|${f(y=3, x=count)}

cases.name: inline-python-closure-bound-once
cases.template:
<%!
def make(ctx):
    def decorate(fn):
        ctx.write('D')
        def wrapped(context, *args, **kwargs):
            return fn(*args, **kwargs)
        return wrapped
    return decorate
%><%def name="outer()"><%def name="inner()" decorator="make(context)">I</%def>${inner()}${inner()}</%def>${outer()}|${outer()}

cases.name: named-block
cases.template:
<%!
def decorate(fn):
    def wrapped(ctx, *args, **kwargs):
        ctx.write('[')
        result = fn(*args, **kwargs)
        ctx.write(']')
        return result
    return wrapped
%><%block name="headline" decorator="decorate">${title}</%block>
